name: read_issue
result_excerpt:
#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue arises because the password reset email link uses the BASE_URL constant, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the reset-password link to point to localhost in environments where PUBLIC_URL is missing or incorrectly configured. To fix this, ensure that the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is set correctly in the deployment environment to the actual public URL of the application so the email links generate properly.
